hypothesis: The positive default-off event overlay bundle from exp-20260504-049 cannot be evaluated as a future live satellite allocation until the SEC negative-reaction source freezes daily paper entries and outcomes in the production path.

alpha_hypothesis.why_this_now: exp-20260504-049 is the strongest current alpha direction; Form 4 and SEC governance/procedural already have paper ledgers, but SEC negative-reaction only had a queue.
alpha_hypothesis.blocked_alpha_if_not_done: The event bundle would remain replay-only and production could not measure replacement value for one of its highest-contributing sources.

single_causal_variable: default-off SEC negative-reaction paper outcome ledger

similar_experiments.exp-20260504-010: SEC negative-reaction standalone sleeve was positive but not production-promoted.
similar_experiments.exp-20260504-012: SEC negative-reaction default-off queue was created but lacked a persistent paper outcome sleeve.
similar_experiments.exp-20260504-034: Form 4 overlay was positive but immaterial and already has a forward paper sleeve.
similar_experiments.exp-20260504-039: SEC governance/procedural overlay passed three-window materiality.
similar_experiments.exp-20260504-044: SEC governance/procedural paper ledger added observe-only.
similar_experiments.exp-20260504-049: Default-off event overlay bundle improved EV and PnL in all three canonical windows, but remained replay-only.

historical_experiment_check.mechanism_insight_check: This does not repeat threshold, keyword, item-code, notional, capacity, holding-period, or source-promotion sweeps. It removes the production observation blocker left by the positive event bundle.

market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull where strategy makes money but lags indexes
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak older tape with lower win rate

gate4.basis: Default-off parity/forward-attribution change. Required check is zero core metric drift across the three canonical windows, plus tests showing no order/ranking/sizing path changes.
gate4.material_alpha_source: exp-20260504-049 already passed the three-window materiality gate as replay-only; this run removes the SEC negative-reaction production observation blocker without promoting live capital.

production_impact.promotion_blocker_remaining: Live capital still requires closed forward paper outcomes and an explicit shared trade-enabled event-sleeve adapter.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm: Production-aligned LLM soft-ranking data remains too sparse; this uses the stronger non-LLM event bundle evidence instead.

decision_rationale: Accepted as observe-only. The highest-value current alpha direction is the default-off external event satellite bundle, and direct live promotion would create a production/backtest attribution gap. The implementation now freezes SEC negative-reaction paper entries and outcomes in production-visible JSON/reporting while leaving core strategy behavior unchanged.
why_not_other_attractive_points: LLM soft-ranking is still data-limited; macro ETF and BEAR_SHALLOW probes were rejected; Form 4 and SEC governance already have observe-only ledgers; core A/B thresholds/ranking/sizing surfaces are saturated by recent failures.
risk_of_change: The new ledger can tempt premature live promotion before forward paper outcomes prove replacement value; the code therefore forces enabled=false and trade_enabled=false.
next_action: Accumulate closed forward paper outcomes across Form 4, SEC negative-reaction, and SEC governance/procedural sources before any trade-enabled event bundle adapter is considered.
